text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer developed body paragraphs with examples","quality":"development","description":"This captures how fully the writer expands ideas with supporting points and explanation."},{"evidence":"organized into sports, book clubs, and community service","quality":"organization","description":"This captures clearer paragraphing and a more coherent overall structure."},{"evidence":"uses transitions like \"First,\" \"Also,\" and \"Every student should\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"This captures the use of linking words and phrases to connect ideas smoothly."},{"evidence":"generally sustained explanation such as \"books are the best option as a break\"","quality":"elaboration","description":"This captures fuller discussion of reasons and examples rather than brief claims."},{"evidence":"mostly controlled sentence flow across paragraphs","quality":"sentence control","description":"This captures greater ability to keep sentences readable and manage clauses with fewer breakdowns."},{"evidence":"fewer severe spelling and word-form problems than B","quality":"mechanics","description":"This captures stronger control of spelling, capitalization, and basic written conventions."}]}
